categories.main_business_segments: Harbin Electric Company Limited primarily operates in manufacturing power generation equipment including thermal power equipment (boilers, steam turbines, generators), hydropower equipment, nuclear power equipment, steam power equipment, and clean energy products such as solar and tidal power. It also engages in turnkey construction of power station projects, after-sales services, import/export of power station equipment, and environmental protection engineering services. The company additionally provides modern manufacturing services and industrial system solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in manufacturing large-scale power generation equipment with single unit capacities up to 1,400MW for nuclear power and 1,000MW for thermal and hydro power. It employs cutting-edge R&D in ultra-supercritical boilers, high-stability pumped storage units, and gas turbines, with digital workshops and intelligent manufacturing processes. The company emphasizes innovation in clean energy technologies and digital transformation in production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Harbin Electric serves primarily power generation companies and industries requiring large-scale power equipment, including thermal, hydro, nuclear, and clean energy sectors. Its customers include domestic Chinese power plants and international clients across Asia, Africa, Europe, and America. Major customers contribute a significant portion of revenue, with the top five customers accounting for over 14% of operating income.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, which accounts for approximately 80% of its revenue. It actively develops international markets, exporting products to over 50 countries and regions across Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Americas. Key export markets include Asia, the Americas, and Europe, with exports representing over 12% of total operating revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Harbin Electric operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the power equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing, engineering, and turnkey construction of power stations. It also provides after-sales services and maintenance, positioning itself as an equipment manufacturer, system integrator, and service provider within the power generation industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-quality development with a focus on technological innovation, increasing R&D intensity, and achieving breakthroughs in major national projects. It emphasizes green, intelligent, and high-end manufacturing, digital transformation, and the development of new energy and clean energy equipment. The company also invests in industrial foundation reconstruction and digital workshops to enhance production efficiency and competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Harbin Electric generates revenue primarily through product sales of power generation equipment, turnkey project contracting (EPC), after-sales services, and export sales. It also earns income from modern manufacturing services, trading, and financial services related to its subsidiaries. Revenue is recognized based on performance obligations fulfilled under contracts, including long-term construction and equipment delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest power plant equipment manufacturers in China, holding significant market shares in thermal, hydro, and nuclear power equipment sectors. It competes with other major Chinese and international power equipment manufacturers, positioning itself as a leading domestic player with growing international presence and advanced technological capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Harbin Electric reported operating income of approximately RMB38.3 billion in 2024, a 32.79% increase year-on-year, with net profit attributable to owners reaching RMB1.686 billion, a 193.33% increase. Total assets stood at about RMB71.95 billion, with steady growth in contracts and production output. The company has a strong financial base with a gearing ratio of 0.11:1 and continues to invest significantly in R&D and capital expenditures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive capabilities in R&D, manufacturing, and power station construction, offering high-efficiency, large-capacity power equipment with advanced technology reaching international standards. Its value proposition includes sustainable development focus, integration of green and clean energy solutions, digital and intelligent manufacturing, and strong after-sales service, enabling it to meet evolving market demands and support China's energy modernization.
